turns.question: How did those five stocks trade over the following sessions, from April 9 through April 15, 2025?

report.markdown:

| Ticker | Return (Apr 9–15) | Start Price | End Price | Avg Daily Volume |
|--------|-------------------|-------------|-----------|------------------|

| BABA   | **+13.1%**        | $99.29      | $112.28   | 30.1 M           |
| MU     | **+8.3%**         | $65.45      | $70.91    | 29.3 M           |
| INTC   | **+8.0%**         | $18.40      | $19.87    | 113.9 M          |

[1]

**Key observations**
- Every stock recovered a meaningful portion of its prior week’s loss.
- AMD led the bounce (+21.5%), followed by AAPL (+17.2%).
- Volume tapered through the week for most names, typical of a relief rally.
